svg.title: Requests to llms.txt files, Ahrefs study, May 2026
svg.desc: Of the files that were valid llms.txt, 97 percent received zero requests and 3 percent received any. Of the requests that did arrive, 19.5 percent came from named AI tools.

g.text: Who reads llms.txt? Ahrefs, 137,210 domains, May 2026
Valid llms.txt files: requests in the month
Requests that did arrive: share from named AI tools
The rest: SEO audit tools, unknown bots, general crawlers

svg.text: Source: Ahrefs, ahrefs.com/blog/llmstxt-study. Shares as reported by Ahrefs.
